info.title: Douzloo API Documentation
info.description: Douzloo SaaS platform REST API. Covers authentication, products, downloads, licensing, CRM, orders, billing (invoices & payments), tickets, and admin operations. All protected endpoints require a Bearer token obtained from `/api/auth/login`.
